# SyncBeats

> SyncBeats is a free web app for synchronized music playback across phones, tablets, and computers. People sign in, join a shared listening room, and play the same track together in their browsers.

## Product
- [Homepage](https://www.syncbeats.in/): Product overview, listening scenarios, FAQs, and Mac app status.
- [Listening guide](https://www.syncbeats.in/how-it-works): Setup steps, supported device categories, music sources, and practical synchronization advice.
- [Detailed product information](https://www.syncbeats.in/llms-full.txt): A plain-text product reference.

## Getting started
Create an account, open the room hub, and create a room. Share its six-digit room code, link, or QR code. Friends sign in and join from their own devices. Add a track, wait for audio readiness, and press play. Any participant can play, pause, or seek.

## Availability and limitations
- The web app is available now and is free to use.
- A native Mac app is in development and coming soon. No release date or public Mac download has been announced.
- The web app requires internet access. Listeners can use different networks.
- Audio uploads and in-room music search are supported. Source availability varies; paid music catalogs are not unlocked by SyncBeats.
- Playback alignment depends on network, browser, and audio hardware. Bluetooth adds output delay. No fixed latency is guaranteed.
- Keep the listening room open; background and battery-saving behavior may interrupt playback.
